name: feedback-memory
description: Remembers why you approved, edited or rejected Claude's drafts, and hands the closest past corrections back before the next draft.
long_description:
When you approve, edit or reject a draft, Claude calls `record_decision` with your reason. Before the next draft it calls `recall_corrections` and gets the closest past corrections and your standing rules back, so the same fix doesn't have to be made twice.

Everything lives in a local Postgres (PGlite + pgvector) in `~/.feedback-memory`. Nothing to host, no account. Leave the OpenAI key empty to match by shared words offline, or add one to match by meaning (text-embedding-3-small).

Tell Claude when to use it, e.g. in a project's instructions: "Before drafting anything I'll review, call recall_corrections with the task. When I approve, edit or reject your draft, call record_decision with my reason."

Only one app can open the same database folder at a time, so don't run this bundle and the Claude Code (npx) install at the same time on one machine.

tools.name: recall_corrections
tools.description: Before drafting: return the closest past corrections and standing rules for a task

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: After you approve, edit or reject a draft: save the decision with your reason

tools.name: add_rule
tools.description: Save a standing rule that always comes back first

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a stored decision or rule

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Leave empty to match by shared words, offline. With a key, corrections are matched by meaning (text-embedding-3-small).
